title: Syllabus
text: This course provides a broad overview of modern methods and tools for big data analytics. Different stages of data analytics lifecycle, including diagnosing, cleaning, preparing, transforming, visualizing and modelling data, are considered. Numerical and graphical methods of descriptive statistics are introduced. Data analytic methods are demonstrated using the statistical computing software R.

title: Syllabus
text:
First-Year Success Tips

Start early — avoid last-minute coding stress.
Practice daily — even 30 minutes a day beats cramming.
Ask questions early — reach out after 15 minutes of being stuck. Use office hours. I have an open door policy ;)
Form study groups — teach among yourselves! This is the best way to learn.

title: DATA100: Introduction to Data Analytics
text:
Welcome to DATA100 — Introduction to Data Analytics! This course introduces you to the fundamentals of data analysis using R, covering everything from R basics and data types to R Markdown/Quarto reporting, data wrangling, and communicating results.
